    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BarChart
    Reusable horizontal chart with a separate scale for each caller-defined group.
    BarChart.Bar
    One immutable chart entry.
    CashierPanel
    Cashier view: pick drinks from the menu, build a cart, choose the employee and payment method, submit the order, and void or return today's orders.
    CashierPanel.LoadedData
    Everything fetched together when the view loads.
    CashierPanel.MoneyRenderer
    Right-aligns a table column and formats BigDecimal values as currency.
    CashierPanel.SubmitResult
    Outcome of a successful submit.
    DataAccessException
    A database operation failed; the message can be displayed by a panel.
    Db
    Opens JDBC connections using the settings in db.properties.
    Employee
    Employee identity used by manager tables and the cashier selector.
    EmployeeDao
    Loads and manages employees in the database.
    EmployeesPanel
    Employee maintenance: list, add, edit and delete employees.
    EmployeesPanel.ViewState
    Result of a background task.
    Format
    Shared display helpers.
    Ingredient
    Inventory ingredient with its stock on hand.
    InventoryDao
    Ingredient inventory persistence.
    InventoryPanel
    Inventory maintenance: list ingredients, add new ones, and edit name, quantity and unit.
    InventoryPanel.ViewState
    Result of a background task.
    Main
    Application window: sidebar navigation plus one card per feature panel.
    MenuDao
    Menu item persistence.
    MenuItem
    A drink at one size, as listed in the manager menu table and the cashier menu.
    MenuPanel
    Menu maintenance: list items and their recipes, add new ones, edit name, size and price, and build a seasonal item's recipe from existing or brand-new inventory ingredients.
    MenuPanel.MoneyRenderer
    Right-aligns a table column and formats BigDecimal values as currency.
    MenuPanel.ViewState
    Result of a background load or save; null lists mean "leave that list as it is".
    OrderDao
    Order persistence.
    OrderLine
    One cart line: a menu item and how many of it were ordered.
    OrderReceipt
    What the cashier sees after an order is saved.
    OrderStatus
    Lifecycle of a saved order.
    OrderSummary
    One row of the cashier's "Today's orders" list.
    PaymentMethod
    How a customer paid.
    RecipeLine
    One ingredient in a drink's recipe and the amount one drink uses, in the ingredient's unit.
    ReportDao
    Loads read-only manager reports from PostgreSQL using the fixed ReportType list.
    ReportDao.DateRange
    Inclusive local-date bounds used to initialize report inputs.
    ReportData
    Disconnected report values, so the UI never owns a JDBC result set.
    ReportData.Column
    One report column.
    ReportsPanel
    Manager report controls, sortable results and the product usage chart.
    ReportsPanel.ReportCellRenderer
    Right-aligns numbers, formats currency and percentages, and highlights the TOTAL row.
    ReportsPanel.ReportTableModel
    Read-only adapter preserving DAO column types for sorting and currency rendering.
    ReportType
    Fixed set of manager reports; users cannot supply SQL or file paths.
    Theme
    Colours, fonts and shared component styling from the Phase 0 sketch (green sidebar, cream background).
